map.：算法：均值 x̄ = Σx ÷ n；中位数为排序后中间值（n 为偶数时取中间两: : Algorithm: mean x̄ = Σx ÷ n; the median is the middle value after sorting (when n is even, the mean of the two middle values); variance σ² = Σ(x − x̄)² ÷ n; standard deviation σ = √σ²; range = maximum − minimum.
